content.short: Coin98 is a leading multi-chain crypto wallet and DeFi gateway providing users with a unified interface for asset management across 100+ networks.
content.description: Coin98 is an all-in-one DeFi super-app that offers a comprehensive suite of tools including a non-custodial wallet, decentralized exchange aggregator, and dApp browser. With full support for the Mantle Network, Coin98 provides users with a seamless and high-performance gateway to explore the entire Mantle ecosystem. Its platform simplifies complex on-chain operations such as swapping tokens and managing cross-chain assets, making it an essential tool for any Mantle user.
content.meta: Coin98 is a leading multi-chain wallet and DeFi gateway with full integration for the Mantle Network. Discover Coin98 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
